summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on npm install
details: The package advertises itself as a React chat UI but ships a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on every `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-mangled `_0x...` identifiers, string-array rotation, encoded literal tables) whose contents are unrelated to a chat UI. Both the launcher (`setup.mjs`) and the payload (`math_init.js`) are obfuscated with the same anti-analysis techniques; the launcher includes probes such as reading `/etc/os-release` and detecting musl/Alpine to select a Bun build. Installing this package auto-executes arbitrary obfuscated code on the installer's machine via an alien runtime fetched from outside the npm registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
